title: Kula Today
heading: Yesterday · Wed 18 Nov
summary: A light day (forecast light). Thermals stayed flat all day. The upslope ran from about 08:45 to about 15:15. Yesterday evening, the page called it normal, about 4,900 ft, a hit. Midday the base averaged about 5,100 ft by the Kekoa camera, 200 ft higher than yesterday evening's number; the morning update said about 4,900 ft, off by 200 ft; at 10:00, from the 09:00 base, about 4,800 ft, off by 300 ft. Most of the day the shear line was crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio; furthest north about 10:37, on Makawao Avenue near Makawao, running toward Kahului. Data gaps: no readings all day from 1 station (Nakula); the Mesonet could not be reached on 18 of 58 updates.
